listing.name: Mirror
listing.summary: Reflects most vanilla weapons based on their installation position relative to the ship's centerline.
listing.aiSummary: Reflects most vanilla weapons based on their installation position relative to the ship's centerline.

description: Mirror is a simple mod that reflects most vanilla weapons, based on where they're installed on your ship. In general, weapons will be mirrored if they are to the left of the ship's centerline and facing forwards, or if they're to the right of the ship's centerline and facing backwards.
descriptionHtml: Mirror is a simple mod that reflects most vanilla weapons, based on where they're installed on your ship. In general, weapons will be mirrored if they are to the left of the ship's centerline and facing forwards, or if they're to the right of the ship's centerline and facing backwards.
aiDescription: Reflects most vanilla weapons based on their installation position relative to the ship's centerline. Weapons are mirrored if they are to the left of the centerline and facing forwards, or to the right and facing backwards. This applies to a wide variety of vanilla weapons, including autocannons, mortars, lasers, and missile launchers.

changelog.1.4: Added mirroring for ion beams and mining lasers
